Luka Modric to continue playing for Croatia

Luka Modric remains available to play for the Croatian national football team, according to the Croatian Football Federation (HNS). This announcement follows speculation that the veteran midfielder might end his international career after the recent World Cup. Modric, who is approaching his 41st birthday, has been a long-standing player for Croatia.
